purpose: Falsify transfer claims beyond historical single-factor/diagonal recordings without selecting a new model from these results.
design: Full independent 4 by 4 physical grid, static equals dynamic object friction
supported_when: Both mass and friction beat the training-median constant baseline with positive lower 95% condition-bootstrap improvement bounds at five attempts.
confidence_scope: Conditional on the five shared starting seeds; physical conditions are bootstrap units, and reordered attempts are not independent new samples.
immutability: Do not retrain or select deployment checkpoints/hyperparameters from pilot or final transfer errors. Preserve the original frozen long-run pipeline and its assessment artifacts.
